en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal in force; windy with showers expected on Sunday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has the Strong Monsoon Signal in effect under the northeast monsoon, with stronger winds and heavier showers possible in places on Sunday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory has the Strong Monsoon Signal in force as a northeast monsoon affects southern China. Fresh to strong easterly winds are expected, occasionally reaching gale force offshore and on high ground.

According to the Observatory’s forecast issued late on Saturday, Sunday will be mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier in some areas with thunderstorms at first, and there will be swells. Temperatures are expected between 26 and 29 degrees Celsius.

The tropical depression over the central South China Sea is forecast to move across the seas south of Hainan Island towards the coast of Vietnam. Under the combined influence of the monsoon and the system, conditions will remain windier with occasional showers over the coast of Guangdong on Sunday before gradual improvement early next week.
Members of the public are advised to take precautions against strong winds, secure loose objects and avoid water sports in exposed areas.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號生效 周日風勢較大有驟雨
zh.dek: 天文台在東北季候風影響下發出強烈季候風信號，周日吹偏東強風，部分地區雨勢較大，間中有雷暴。
body: 香港天文台發出強烈季候風信號，東北季候風正影響華南，本港吹清勁至強風的偏東風，離岸及高地間中達烈風程度。
根據天文台周六晚的預報，周日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，部分地區雨勢較大，初時間中有雷暴，並有湧浪。氣溫介乎26至29度。
南海中部的熱帶低氣壓預計橫過海南島以南海域，移向越南沿岸。在季候風及該系統共同影響下，周日廣東沿岸風勢較大，間中有驟雨，其後天氣會逐漸好轉。
市民應提防強風，穩固室外物件，並避免在當風地方進行水上活動。
